changelog:
alibabacloud-pai-dsw-manage v0.0.2 changelog

- Increased minimum Aliyun CLI version from 3.3.1 to 3.3.3.
- Updated installation instructions: Added mandatory plugin update step (`aliyun plugin update`).
- Enforced user-agent string: All CLI commands must now include `--user-agent AlibabaCloud-Agent-Skills/alibabacloud-pai-dsw-manage`.
- Clarified installation and workspace listing procedures for greater accuracy and reliability.
- Improved documentation for parameter confirmation and version verification.
summary: Manage the full lifecycle of Alibaba Cloud PAI DSW (Data Science Workshop) instances — create, update, query, list, start, stop, and look up ECS specs. Trigg...
